content.value: Consider disk with an advertised average seek time of 4 ms, rotation speed 12000 rpm and (10) 512 byte sectors with 500 sectors per track. We wish to read a file consisting of 6 tracks. Find total average access time for: (i) sequential access and (ii) random access.
